name: flow_party_panel_renders_state
description: Joined to a party on a server (the fake sequencer in lobby mode), the hub's left well shows it as the server's PARTY_STATE says: 2/4, a row per member with its seat glyph, name and Builder, the leader's crown and Ready ticks, my own row in gold, open rows as + invite; a member on another rules version reads 'needs to reload' and holds the one button. The strip says where the party lives and its code.

steps.msg: a code joins (on the official server, here the loopback)
while connecting the button waits, and says why

steps.assert: node('HubPanel').lines() == ['diamond Ana lookout leader', 'circle Sascha lamplighter', '+ invite', '+ invite']
steps.msg: a row per member: seat glyph, name, Builder; the leader's crown; open rows invite

steps.assert: node('Place').text == 'Online · play.loopback.test' and node('Code').text == 'K7Q-4M' and node('CodeBox').visible
steps.msg: the strip: online, the server and the party code
a member's one button is Ready
my Ready comes back as a tick, and the button offers Not ready

steps.wait_until: node('HubPanel').lines()[2] == 'triangle Ben lamplighter needs to reload'

steps.msg: a member on another version holds the one button: Ben needs to reload
and lets go once Ben has reloaded
